home.hero.title: Specialist care for piles, fissure & fistula

home.cond.title: Conditions we focus on
home.cond.lede: Anorectal problems are nothing to be embarrassed about — they are common, and with a proper examination the right treatment can be chosen.
home.cond.piles.d: Blood during bowel movements, itching, pain or a lump — typical signs of piles. Treatment depends on the type and severity.
home.cond.fissure.d: A sudden, sharp or burning pain when passing stool — if it lasts for weeks, it can become a chronic fissure.
home.cond.fistula.d: Repeated discharge of pus near the anus with pain and swelling — a fistula usually does not heal on its own.
home.cond.other.d: Itching, lumps, constipation or bleeding — a proper examination and consultation matters to confirm the cause.

home.faq.title: What patients often ask
home.faq.1.q: Do I need a referral for an appointment?
home.faq.1.a: No. You can fix a time directly by calling (+880 1716-528757) or emailing us.
home.faq.2.a: No. In many cases medicines, diet and lifestyle changes, or simple procedures bring relief. What you need is explained after the examination.
home.faq.3.q: If there is blood, is it definitely piles?
home.faq.3.a: It cannot be assumed — bleeding has several possible causes, so especially the first time, seeing a doctor is essential.
home.faq.4.a: Yes. Consultation, examination and treatment are all handled confidentially.
home.cta.t: Make the call today — talk about your problem
home.cta.d: Don't delay out of embarrassment or fear. Timely advice is the easy path to treatment.
